## Important

- app/display.py:13 — comments — Use the history revision identifier in running status — For revision `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, running status shows `0123456` while history shows `0123456789ab`. The docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but status uses `revision[:7]` and history uses `revision[:12]`. — Deployments whose revisions share seven characters but differ within the first twelve display the same revision identifier while running.
